theme: Dark Mode Default (The Performance Pro / High-Contrast Analytics)

typography.headings: Outfit (Google Fonts) - Sharp, professional, high-impact. Use for H1, H2, H3.
typography.body: Inter (Google Fonts) - Clean, highly legible at small sizes.
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono (Google Fonts) - Mandatory for URLs, API keys, prices, and terminal/status output.
typography.weights: High contrast: Use Light (300) for elegance, Bold (700) or Black (900) for impact. Avoid medium everywhere.
typography.hierarchy_rules: Tight tracking on headings (`tracking-tighter`), loose leading on body (`leading-relaxed`). Limit H1 to `text-5xl`.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (`border-border`). No generic soft shadows. Use inner glow (`shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]`) on buttons and active cards.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Crisp background color shifts, text color brightening. All interactive elements MUST have explicitly defined hover text colors.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used exclusively for sticky headers, floating action bars, or modal overlays (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`). Never use generic opacity without blur.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise/grain overlay fixed in the background at 2-3% opacity to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Minimalist, utilizing generous negative space. Center align the empty state illustration with JetBrains Mono helper text.

layouts.dashboard_shell: Collapsible left sidebar for navigation. Main content area with massive generous padding (`p-8` to `p-12`).
layouts.scraper_view: Centered, high-focus command center. URL input area should be massive (`text-2xl`).
layouts.product_details: Bento Grid (Mode B). Image gallery spans 2 columns on the left. Specs, location, shipping, and description stack on the right.
layouts.library: High-density layout. Use a data table with tight spacing or a grid of dense cards. Include a sticky header for bulk actions.
layouts.watchlist: Card grid with inline Recharts sparklines (LineChart) for historical price tracking.

components.inputs: Shadcn UI Input, customized with JetBrains Mono text, sharp corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`), 1px border. Deep background.
components.buttons: Sharp edges, high contrast. Primary button has Electric Blue background with white text. Loading state must show spinner/loader.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for switching views (e.g., Settings: API Keys vs General).
components.toasts: Sonner (bottom-right) for scraping statuses (Success, Blocked, Retrying...).
components.charts: Recharts for price history. Minimalist: hide grid lines, use an Electric Blue stroke for the line, no background fill.
components.icons: lucide-react (functional, clean, scale relative to text size).

motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion: Fade in and slight slide up (`y: 10 -> 0`) for page content.
motion.scraping_state: Pulsing/shimmering border animation on the URL input container while scraping is in progress.
motion.gallery: Smooth crossfade transition when switching product images in the carousel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially grey text, meets WCAG AA against the `#0A0A0A` background.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., `import-item-button`, `ebay-url-input`, `api-key-input`).

empty_state.description: Empty cardboard box. Use for 'No items scraped yet' empty states.

placeholder_product_1.description: Sony Camera for mock Scraped Items Library.

placeholder_product_2.description: Macbook Pro for mock Scraped Items Library.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Rely on raw HTML/Tailwind for complex overlapping or bento layouts.
Implement Shadcn UI for standard interactions (Dialog, Select, Tabs, Dropdown, Table), but strip generic 'Vercel-look' styling to match the Performance Pro theme.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications. Ensure toasts provide specific scraping status (e.g., 'API Scraper fallback initiated', 'Ebay AU Blocked - Retrying').
For the Scraper view, visually emphasize the 'eBay Australia Only' constraint (e.g., an AU flag or distinct label near the input).
For Item Details, ensure the location and shipping costs are highly visible, as these are critical for AU buyers.
Implement bulk selection checkboxes in the Library view to allow deleting or moving multiple items.
In the Settings panel, ensure ScraperAPI and ScrapingBee keys use password-type inputs for security.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or overlapping elements. Use `bg-[#121212]` or `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80`.
Include a dynamic scraping status indicator (e.g., 'Using Manual Server Scraping', 'Using ScraperAPI (Auto)') on the active scrape card.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize depth through layered design (z-index) instead of flat layouts.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use optical alignment and asymmetrical bento grids.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
